findings.text: During a 12-second window with no user interaction, the page made 315 requests to 68 third-party domains (median of 2 passes).
Of 40.0 MB transferred in that window (compressed responses that finished loading), 29.6 MB (74%) came from third-party domains, 1.0 MB of it from services classified as tracking (165 requests).

37 third-party services classified as advertising, analytics, social or audience measurement were contacted before any interaction: 1rx.io (RhythmOne (Magnite), advertising), 2mdn.net (Google, advertising), 360yield.com (Improve Digital, advertising), 3lift.com (TripleLift, advertising), acuityplatform.com (Acuity Ads, advertising), adform.net (Adform, advertising), adnxs.com (Microsoft (Xandr), advertising), ads.linkedin.com (LinkedIn, advertising), adsrvr.org (The Trade Desk, advertising), amazon-adsystem.com (Amazon, advertising).
133 cookies were set by third-party domains (165 cookies in total).
The main document response did not include a Content-Security-Policy header or meta tag.

With the EasyPrivacy filter list applied (domain rules only, 47296 rules), 79 requests were blocked. The page still made 315 requests to 68 third-party domains, including 37 tracking services in our list.
